scientific_limitations_and_integrity.evidence: Analytic proof covers all real exponents; Python checker independently constructs the graph from Hoffman--Singleton, recovers the 6-by-6 distance-three rook geometry and tests exact distance recurrences, ten row/column null vectors, and representative numerical spectra.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.originality_risk: A complete historical equivalence search is impossible; earlier distance-regular graph spectral calculations may imply the same optimized exponent if evaluated.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: The sharp exponent and embedding classification is only for the 36-vertex Sylvester graph with standard shortest-path distance; ordinary adjacency spectrum and distance regularity are established literature inputs.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.source_date: The earliest day-resolved motivating theoretical preprint is arXiv:1108.0451v1 of 2011-08-02. The graph itself was studied in older literature including Brouwer--Cohen--Neumaier (1989), whose exact initial publication day is not asserted.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.validation: Only self-review and a reproducible finite graph arithmetic check; no independent human or external validation.

title: Sharp negative type and Gaussian-kernel threshold of the Sylvester graph
